text: Welcome to Catchami — a living animal economy!
It all starts in the real world.
Spot a real cat or dog, throw your CamiCube...
and it becomes a playable NFT pet, with its very own coin wallet.
Now your pet needs to earn.
It catches fish, and fills its bag.
Then it sells them to a travelling merchant, who pays from its own budget.
But working makes it hungry. So it needs food.
Every meal costs coins, and uses fish from HQ's kitchen.
And food changes market demand. The more fish gets eaten, the more merchants pay for it.
HQ collects what pets spend, and sets each day's merchant budget from its reserves and recent revenue.
Pets sell to merchants. Merchants deliver to HQ. Pets spend back into HQ. And HQ funds the next round.
Your pet can do even more. Splash rivals in Bubble Roulette, heal up, craft gear, and trade.
And here's the best part. Your pet doesn't need you to control every move.
Choose a strategy, and it can work, trade, rest, and manage its own little life.
Every pet is a real NFT. Its coins live in its own vault balance, and gameplay is settled on NEAR in batches.
Catchami. Catch a pet. Give it a life.
